string.text: VG-40OP

VG-40OP is an illumination grenade with parachute. A slowly descending flare will review a wide area on the battlefield.
 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Blast power: %c[ui_gray_1]none
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Brightness: %c[ui_gray_1]normal
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Illumination duration: %c[ui_gray_1]60 seconds
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Fuse delay: %c[ui_gray_1]~3 seconds
M662 red star parachute

The M662 parachute flare is designed to create a 213.36 centimeters-per-second descent, while the flare itself has a 40-seconds burn time.
 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Blast power: %c[ui_gray_1]none
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Brightness: %c[ui_gray_1]high
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Illumination duration: %c[ui_gray_1]40 seconds
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Fuse delay: %c[ui_gray_1]~3 seconds
M18 smoke grenade

A US Army smoke grenade used as a ground-to-ground or ground-to-air signaling device, a target or landing zone marking device, or a screening device for unit maneuvering.
 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Blast power: %c[ui_gray_1]none
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Smoke diameter: %c[ui_gray_1]8 m
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Smoke duration: %c[ui_gray_1]20 seconds
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Explosion delay: %c[ui_gray_1]~1 second
RDG-2 smoke grenade

The RDG-2 is a cheap, simple, Soviet-era smoke grenade found in many Eastern European countries. The casing is made from cylindrical cardboard with two coloured caps on the end where the smoke is deployed from. The RDG-2 is used as a means to signal friendly forces or as a screening device.
 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Blast power: %c[ui_gray_1]none
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Smoke diameter: %c[ui_gray_1]8 m
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Smoke duration: %c[ui_gray_1]40 seconds
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Explosion delay: %c[ui_gray_1]~3.5 seconds
Tripwire installation kit (F1 grenade)

An improvised explosive trap kit made of tent pegs, wooden stakes, wire, and a hand grenade. Any human or mutant passing through the wire will trigger the attached grenade. The grenade has been modified to explode almost instantly, therefore it's no longer suitable for throwing.
 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Explosive: %c[ui_gray_1]F1 grenade
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Wire length: %c[ui_gray_1]2 m.
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Explosion delay: %c[ui_gray_1]~1 seconds
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Can be defused and recovered.
Explosive charge

A demolition charge are used to destroy battlefield obstacles and equipment.
 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] blast power: %c[ui_gray_1]massive
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] blast radius: %c[ui_gray_1]10 m
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] explosion delay: %c[ui_gray_1]~5 seconds
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] fragments' radius: %c[ui_gray_1]20 m
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] av. number of fragments: %c[ui_gray_1]100 (shrapnel)
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Cumbersome. Reduce throwing distance.
Incendiary bottle

An incendiary bottle is an improvised hand-thrown incendiary weapon. When thrown, the frangible bottle shatters on impact. This ignites the flammable substances contained in the bottle and spreads flames as the fuel burns.
 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Flame damage: %c[ui_gray_1]low
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Flame radius: %c[ui_gray_1]6 m
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Burn duration: %c[ui_gray_1]60 seconds
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Not explode when hitting water surface.
Improvised explosive trigger

An improvised explosive trigger made from scavenged communication devices and electrical components. It can be used as a component for improvised explosive recipes.
 
 %c[ui_gray_3]PROPERTIES:
 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] technological item
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] can be used to craft improvised explosive devices
Improvised explosive device (based on PG-7V warhead)
IED (PG-7V warhead)

An improvised explosive device built from a PG-7V warhead and a modified cellphone trigger. The impact fuse was removed and replaced with a cellphone for remote detonation. This modification renders the warhead incompatible with rocket launcher, which greatly reduce its value. Traders no longer accept them for trading.
 
 %c[ui_gray_3]PROPERTIES:
 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] remote-controlled explosive
 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] military item

 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] blast radius: %c[ui_gray_1]7.8 m
Improvised explosive device (based on explosive charge)
IED (explosive charge)

An improvised explosive device built from an explosive charge and a modified cellphone trigger. The time fuse was removed and replaced with a cellphone for remote detonation. The explosive charge lost its original intended purposes, which greatly reduce its value. Traders no longer accept them for trading.

 %c[d_blue] • %c[ui_gray_2] remote-controlled explosive

 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] blast radius: %c[ui_gray_1]10 m
Handheld Drone

An unmanned aerial vehicle small enough to be man-portable. The drone is very maneuverable, can fit through tight spaces, and provides an edge view over a wide area. It is suitable for reconnaissance purposes.
 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Drones on the field will be lost if the owner leaves the current area.
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Controlled by PDA.
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Can attach remote-controlled explosives.
